title: Maximum Streak Length
scenario: For every number, find the maximum number of times it appeared consecutively. Return 'num' and 'MaxStreak'.
hint: Subtract row number from id per number to form islands.
correctQuery: SELECT num, MAX(streak) AS "MaxStreak" FROM (SELECT num, COUNT(*) AS streak FROM (SELECT id, num, id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY num ORDER BY id)::INT AS grp FROM logs) t GROUP BY num, grp) t2 GROUP BY num;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (2, '1'), (3, '2'), (4, '2'), (5, '2');
